claim: The ICML 2024 'Surrogate Sensitivity' paper, by the same author group as IGNITE, regulates surrogate sensitivity to seek a 'less sensitive' surrogate only -- never a deliberately more-sensitive/rougher one -- and contains no Gaussian process experiment, only a single bibliography citation to an unrelated GP kernel-robustness paper.
stance_target: N7: the Dao/Nguyen/Truong/Hoang author lineage has manipulated smoothness bidirectionally across its 2024-2025 papers
quoted_support: This raises the following questions: (1) how to regulate the sensitivity of a surrogate model; and (2) whether conditioning an offline optimizer with such less sensitive surrogate will lead to better optimization performance.
